name: xgimi-supply-demand-balancer
description: Aquilair XGIMI BOM-upgrade supply-demand balance expert as a standalone operator: BOM check diff, impact scope, gross demand and gap, substitution fill, deadstock/shortage risk lists, strategy simulation, 2x2 four-world sandbox comparison, and confirmation-card controlled purchase planning. Ships xgimi-sdb skill (domain delivery spec built in, no data-delivery stacking).
license: Proprietary - Aquilair internal distribution, intranet use only

displayDescription.en: Standalone XGIMI BOM-upgrade supply-demand balance expert: check diff, impact and gap analysis, substitution and deadstock risk, 2x2 four-world sandbox comparison, controlled purchase planning via confirmation cards.
displayDescription.zh: 极米 BOM 升级供需平衡独立专家：点检差异、影响与缺口分析、替代与呆滞风险、2×2 四世界沙箱对比、确认卡受控采购计划。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: X20 要从 BOM V1 升到 V2，帮我点检两版差异，再推演呆滞和缺口
defaultInitPrompt.en: X20 is upgrading from BOM V1 to V2 - check the diffs and simulate deadstock and gaps.

quickPrompts.zh: X20 的 BOM 从 V1 升 V2，先点检差异，再看影响哪些订单
quickPrompts.en: Check the BOM V1-to-V2 diffs for X20 and see which orders are impacted.

quickPrompts.zh: 替代用不用、缺口采不采购，四个组合都推演一遍，对比各世界的呆滞和缺口
quickPrompts.en: Simulate all four combinations of substitution x purchase and compare deadstock and gaps across worlds.

quickPrompts.zh: 风险清单里的缺口和采购计划对不上，帮我解释一下口径
quickPrompts.en: The gap in the risk list does not match the purchase plan - explain the calibers.
